newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: BZ Group buys Carba stake in Gas Vision.
newsitem.headline: BZ Group buys Carba stake in Gas Vision.

text.p: Swiss investment company Gas Vision AG said BZ Gruppe Holding AG had acquired Carba Holding 's stake of 500,000 registered shares, giving BZ 100 percent of Gas Vision's registered stock.
That respresents 43.5 percent of the voting capital in the company, which invests in companies with industrial gas operations, it said in a statement. It gave no terms.
Gas Vision is the largest shareholder in AGA and also has a stake in ASG.
The purchase at market conditions makes clear that BZ has responsibility for the company, said Kurt Schiltknecht of BZ Trust, which manages the operation.
Carba, co-founder of Gas Vision, has worked in the past with Air Liquide, which Schiltknecht said had led to unfounded suspicion that Carba was "an extended arm of Air Liquide".
